fields.help: HER2 (black) and CEP17 (red) signals in at least 20 non-overlapping invasive tumour nuclei, as on the QMH calculator. The cells counted, both averages, the ratio and the result below fill in from the counts; Enter moves to the next box. Not printed.

reference.title: ASCO/CAP HER2 dual ISH & IHC scoring (Groups 1–5)
reference.intro: Count HER2 (black) and CEP17 (red) signals in at least 20 non-overlapping invasive tumour nuclei. Integrate concurrent HER2 IHC for ISH Groups 2–4 (2018/2023 ASCO/CAP algorithm).
reference.note: Photomicrographs are from Wikimedia Commons under open Creative Commons licences. ExpertPath pages open with your own ExpertPath login; the app holds none of their images.

groups.heading: HER2 ISH amplification, equivocal polysomy & IHC 3+ reference
points: Group 1 (Positive): HER2/CEP17 >= 2.0 AND mean HER2 >= 4.0 signals/cell.
Group 5 (Negative): HER2/CEP17 < 2.0 AND mean HER2 < 4.0 signals/cell.
Groups 2–4 require concurrent IHC review and blinded recount by a second observer if IHC is 2+: Groups 2 and 4 are positive only with IHC 3+; Group 3 is positive with IHC 2+ or 3+.

fields.label: Concurrent HER2 IHC score (Groups 2-4)
fields.help: Not printed. Groups 2-4 take their result from it (ASCO/CAP 2018; CAP 2023 algorithm): Groups 2 and 4 are positive only with IHC 3+, Group 3 with IHC 2+ or 3+; IHC 2+ asks for a blinded recount by a second observer first.
